entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 0
entities.description: SRB used for RRC messages over CCCH logical channel.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 1
entities.description: SRB used for RRC messages (may include piggybacked NAS) and NAS messages prior to SRB2 establishment, using DCCH logical channel.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 2
entities.description: SRB used for NAS messages and RRC messages with logged measurement information, using DCCH logical channel. Configured after AS security activation with lower priority than SRB1.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 3
entities.description: SRB used for specific RRC messages in (NG)EN-DC or NR-DC, using DCCH logical channel.

entities.name: Signalling Radio Bearer 4
entities.description: SRB used for RRC messages with application layer measurement report information, using DCCH logical channel. Configured after AS security activation.

entities.name: AS Security Activation
entities.description: Condition where Access Stratum security is activated, enabling integrity protection and ciphering for RRC messages.

entities.name: Split SRB
entities.description: Feature supporting split signalling radio bearers for MR-DC options in SRB1 and SRB2.

entities.name: Channel Access Priority Class 1
entities.description: Highest priority CAPC assigned to SRB0, SRB1, and SRB3 for shared spectrum channel access.

relations.description: RRC messages on SRB1 are integrity protected and ciphered after AS security activation.
RRC messages on SRB2 are integrity protected and ciphered after AS security activation.
RRC messages on SRB3 are integrity protected and ciphered after AS security activation.
RRC messages on SRB4 are integrity protected and ciphered after AS security activation.
Split SRB is supported for SRB1 in MR-DC options.
Split SRB is supported for SRB2 in MR-DC options.
SRB0 is assigned CAPC 1 for shared spectrum channel access.
SRB1 is assigned CAPC 1 for shared spectrum channel access.
SRB3 is assigned CAPC 1 for shared spectrum channel access.
